title: Excavation Zone B and planned foundation handover

versions.body:
DRAFT FOR SITE MANAGER REVIEW
10 November 2026 | Riverside Office Block
From: Sam Reed, Site Manager, Riverside Build JV
To: Client Project Manager, Riverside Developments
Contract reference: [MISSING: contract reference]
Applicable clause: [MISSING: relevant contract clause]

## Subject: Excavation Zone B and planned foundation handover

Dear Project Manager,

At 10:00 today the Zone B foreman reported a hydraulic hose failure on the excavator. Three workers could no longer continue excavation in that zone. The equipment register and shift report identify the machine as EX-02. [1][2][3]

The signed daily report records 65 m³ excavated against the scheduled 100 m³. This leaves a shortfall of 35 m³, or 35%. Foundations Zone B is due to start on 12 November after the excavation handover. That start is at risk. [3][4]

GroundWorks had reported on 6 November that routine servicing was overdue. The maintenance email records the service status; the cause of the hose failure remains under review. [5] The mechanic currently expects a return to service at noon tomorrow. We will update you once the crew confirms the restart and we can assess the handover date. [6]

Please confirm receipt and coordinate the foundation booking with us following the next progress update.

Sam Reed
Site Manager
